name: United Carton Industries Company
summary: United Carton Industries Company provides various paper-based packaging solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company's corrugated carton products include regular slotted containers, half slotted containers, die cut containers, wrap around cases, high graphic flexographic printing, stitched boxes, and digitally printed corrugated stands and boxes; folding carton products comprise crush lock bottom cases, flat supply products, and round cheese boxes; pulp products; and containerboard products comprising test liner and fluting. Its products are used in various industries, including food, beverages, pharmaceuticals, hardware, shipping, and storage and retail packagin…
